terms.gloss: a tent-mate, a comrade; a companion
terms.comment: The soldier who shares one’s tent; then any close companion (Lewis & Short).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 185, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
